snippet.title: PlayStation - A-Ressha de Ikou Z - Mezase! Tairiku Oudan (1999) - [Intro]
snippet.description:
DESCRIPTION
A-Ressha de Ikou Z: Mezase! Tairiku Oudan is a Strategy game, developed and published by Artdink, which was released in Japan in 1999.
